add_member_to_list.name: add_member_to_list
add_member_to_list.description: Add a new subscriber to an audience or update existing subscriber

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

email_type.description: Type of email this member wants to receive

skip_merge_validation.description: Accept member data without merge field values even if required

aiMetadata.description: Upserts a member into a Mailchimp audience (list) keyed on the email address: creates the subscriber if absent (using the "status if new" value) or updates the existing record otherwise. Use to ensure a contact exists with given status, name, language, or VIP flag without checking first. Requires the target list and email; repeating with the same input is safe and converges to the same member state.

add_note_to_subscriber.name: add_note_to_subscriber
add_note_to_subscriber.description: Add a note to a subscriber in your Mailchimp audience.

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

email.description: The email address of the subscriber to add a note to

note.description: The note content to add to the subscriber

aiMetadata.description: Appends an internal note to a subscriber, identified by email within a given audience (list). Use to record context or annotations on a contact. Not idempotent: each call adds a new note even if the content is identical.

add_subscriber_to_tag.name: add_subscriber_to_tag
add_subscriber_to_tag.description: Add a subscriber to a specific tag in your Mailchimp audience.

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

email.description: The email address of the subscriber to add to the tag

tag_name.description: The name of the tag to add the subscriber to

aiMetadata.description: Activates a tag on a subscriber, identified by email within a given audience (list); the tag is created if it does not already exist. Use to segment or label a contact. Idempotent: re-applying an already-active tag leaves the member state unchanged.

remove_subscriber_from_tag.name: remove_subscriber_from_tag
remove_subscriber_from_tag.description: Remove a subscriber from a specific tag in your Mailchimp audience.

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

email.description: The email address of the subscriber to remove from the tag

tag_name.description: The name of the tag to remove the subscriber from

aiMetadata.description: Deactivates a tag on a subscriber, identified by email within a given audience (list). Use to un-segment or un-label a contact. Idempotent: removing a tag the member does not have leaves the state unchanged.

update_member_in_list.name: update_member_in_list
update_member_in_list.description: Update a member in an existing Mailchimp audience (list)

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

aiMetadata.description: Updates the subscription status (subscribed, unsubscribed, cleaned, pending, transactional) of an existing member in an audience (list), identified by email. Use to change a known contact's status; the member must already exist, or the call fails. Idempotent: setting the same status repeatedly converges to that state.

campaign_type.description: The type of campaign to create

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

subject_line.description: The subject line for the campaign

from_name.description: The name that will appear in the "From" field

from_email.description: The email address that will appear in the "From" field

reply_to.description: The email address that will receive replies

to_name.description: The name that will appear in the "To" field (e.g., *|FNAME|*)

content_type.description: How the campaign content is put together

content_url.description: The URL where the campaign content is hosted (required if content_type is "url")

template_id.description: The ID of the template to use (required if content_type is "template")

html_content.description: The HTML content for the campaign (required if content_type is "html")

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new draft campaign of a chosen type (regular, plain-text, A/B, RSS, or variate) targeting an audience (list), and optionally sets its content from inline HTML, a hosted URL, or a template depending on the selected content type. Use to set up a campaign for later sending; this does not send it. Not idempotent: each call creates a distinct campaign.

get_campaign_report.name: get_campaign_report
get_campaign_report.description: Get comprehensive report details for a specific sent campaign including opens, clicks, bounces, and performance metrics

campaign_id.description: Select the campaign to get information for

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (e.g., "opens.unique_opens,clicks.click_rate")

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude (e.g., "timeseries,_links")

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the analytics report for a single sent campaign by campaign ID, covering opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, and engagement metrics; optional field include/exclude lists narrow the payload. Use to read performance for a campaign that has already been sent. Read-only and idempotent. Returns a not-found result if the campaign has not been sent or the ID is wrong.

company.description: Company name for list contact information

address1.description: Street address for list contact information

state.description: State or province for list contact information

zip.description: ZIP or postal code for list contact information

from_email.description: Default from email address for campaigns

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new audience (list) in the Mailchimp account, including the required physical contact address, permission reminder, and default campaign sender settings. list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

subscriber_hash.description: MD5 hash of the lowercase email address, email address, or contact_id

aiMetadata.description: Archives a member from an audience (list); the identifier accepts an MD5 hash of the lowercase email, the raw email (auto-hashed), or a contact_id. Use to remove a contact from active sending while preserving their record. Idempotent: archiving an already-archived or absent member converges to the same state.

unsubscribe_email.name: unsubscribe_email
unsubscribe_email.description: Unsubscribe an email address from an audience

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

skip_merge_validation.description: Accept member data without merge field values even if required

aiMetadata.description: Sets an email address to unsubscribed status within an audience (list) via a batch upsert; with "update existing" on, it changes an existing member, otherwise it can add the address as unsubscribed. find_campaign.name: find_campaign
find_campaign.description: Search all campaigns for the specified query terms

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude

aiMetadata.description: Searches all campaigns in the account by a free-text query (matching titles, subject lines, and related fields) and returns the matches. Use to locate a campaign by name or wording before reading or acting on it. Read-only and idempotent; a query is required.

find_customer.name: find_customer
find_customer.description: Find a customer by email address in a store

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

aiMetadata.description: Looks up e-commerce customers in a specified connected store by email address, with optional pagination and field filtering. Use to retrieve a store customer record before referencing or syncing it. Requires a store and email; read-only and idempotent.

find_tag.name: find_tag
find_tag.description: Search for tags on a list by name

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

name.description: Search query to filter tags (optional - if empty, returns all tags)

aiMetadata.description: Searches the tags defined on an audience (list): an empty tag-name fetches all tags, while a provided name filters to matching tags. Use to discover available tags or confirm a tag exists before tagging contacts. Requires the target list; read-only and idempotent.

find_subscriber.name: find_subscriber

exclude_fields.description: Fields to exclude from the response. Use dot notation for nested fields

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a subscriber by exact email, returning merge fields, interests, and activity data: when an audience (list) is specified it checks that one list, and when left empty it searches every list in the account. create_tag.name: create_tag

list_id.description: Audience you want to add the contact to

name.description: The name of the tag to create

send_campaign.name: send_campaign
send_campaign.description: Send a draft campaign to the subscribers in its audience, segment, or tag

campaign_id.description: Select the draft campaign to send

aiMetadata.description: Sends an existing draft campaign to its configured recipients immediately (RSS campaigns follow their schedule instead).
